d: The Grizzlies defeated the Hornets, 117-111 tonight in Charlotte. Ty Jerome contributed a team-high 29 points to go with 7 three pointers 4 rebounds and 3 assists, with Cam Spencer of the Grizzlies adding an additional 24 points (5-7 FG, 3-5 3P) in the game. Christian Anderson finished with a team-high 25 points along with 6 three pointers for the Hornets in the losing effort. The Grizzlies improve their record to 13-5 with the win, while the Hornets fall to 4-12 for the season.
